optimizedRevision: Working tree based on d32e8f0 after loading and interaction changes; measured before the separately validated late-mounted Tour highlight correction.
conditions: Chromium, cold cache, 40 ms latency, 10 Mbps, 4x CPU throttle, viewport height 900. Content is the first rendered editor line, tour lesson, AI landing, or AI workspace shell. LCP/CLS observed until two seconds after content/font readiness. Resource totals exclude workers and unfinished requests. AI workspace uses a fresh local store with onboarding completed; no AI requests are submitted.
notes: Baseline: three samples per cell (48 total); intermediate: three (48); optimized: two (32). All samples are retained here without resource URL lists.
The intermediate run predates the final AI entry sibling split and CoreContent highlighter deferral; it is retained for audit and is not used in the comparison tables.

Measurements were not collected on an isolated host. Some baseline samples overlapped tests, and the optimized run also showed substantial timing variation. These timings do not establish a production speedup or a Playground startup regression.
JavaScript bytes count completed page downloads before the content milestone; scheduling can change this total when optional editor chunks arrive early. Workers and unfinished requests are excluded.
